name: ai-tool
title: AI Tool
description: Framework-agnostic consumer endpoint that registers a Camel route as an LLM tool in the shared AiToolRegistry.
label: ai

properties.name: toolName
properties.description: The tool name. This is the name the LLM sees and uses to invoke the tool.

properties.name: argSchema
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Raw JSON Schema for tool input parameters. Supports inline JSON and resource references (classpath:, file:, resource:). Mutually exclusive with the parameter multi-value options. Use for nested objects, arrays, oneOf, and other complex schemas.

properties.name: description
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Human-readable description of what this tool does. Passed verbatim to the LLM; be precise and action-oriented. When omitted, defaults to the tool name.

properties.name: destructiveHint
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: MCP hint that the tool may perform destructive or irreversible updates. Advisory for MCP clients; not enforced by Camel.

properties.name: idempotentHint
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: MCP hint that repeating the tool call with the same arguments has no additional effect. Advisory for MCP clients; not enforced by Camel.

properties.name: openWorldHint
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: MCP hint that the tool interacts with external systems outside the application's control. Advisory for MCP clients; not enforced by Camel.

properties.name: parameters
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Tool input parameters. Format: parameter.NAME=TYPE, parameter.NAME.description=TEXT, parameter.NAME.required=true or false, parameter.NAME.enum=val1,val2. Supported types: string, integer, number, boolean. Mutually exclusive with argSchema. This is a multi-value option with prefix: parameter.

properties.name: readOnlyHint
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: MCP hint that the tool only reads data and does not modify state. Advisory for MCP clients; not enforced by Camel.

properties.name: returnDirect
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: When true, AI producers that support agentic tool loops (such as camel-openai) return this tool's result directly to the caller without sending it back to the model. Also published as an MCP tool annotation when the tool is exposed via camel-mcp-server.

properties.name: tags
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Comma-separated list of tags used to group tools. Producers filter the registry by these tags to select which tools to expose to the LLM. When omitted, the tool goes into a default pool available to all producers.

properties.name: title
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Optional display title for MCP tool listings. Advisory hint for MCP clients only.

properties.name: bridgeErrorHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.
